The second pathway connects staurosporine to Homeodomain-interacting protein kinase 3, which is targeted by Sinocalycanchinensin G, another compound that also targets the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 4. These findings collectively indicate that staurosporine may exert its biological effects through different molecular mechanisms that ultimately converge on the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 4.
